intent.summary: P10-B batch: build a real-PostgreSQL isolated-schema end-to-end lane for the PCS backend so the SPEC's 18 scenarios, 5 WF-PATH routes and the permission matrix run against the real app and a real database (not SQLite), and get the 5 'real backend channel' frontend UI flows actually running (that channel had never really run before and caught 5 defects). Binding constraints from the intent: the lane uses an isolated schema (CREATE SCHEMA -> alembic upgrade head -> DROP CASCADE) and the default lane must skip e2e cases so it never touches the dev database pcs; the PG lane and the E2E lane share one database so they must be mutually excluded (flock); the lane must be able to catch the class of defect where unit tests (SQLite) are green but the real database explodes, so the driver must match production; the permission semantics are cross-project => 404 (same shape as 'not found') and insufficient role => 403. Only 8 product-code sites were changed in this batch; everything else is tests/docs.

requirements: R1: E2E lane runs on an isolated schema in a real PostgreSQL database (CREATE SCHEMA -> alembic upgrade head -> DROP CASCADE) and the default lane (`uv run pytest`) skips every e2e case so it can never write to the dev database pcs / pcs_test
R2: all 18 SPEC scenarios E2E-001..E2E-018 pass in the E2E lane (case count >= 18)
R3: all five WF-PATH route classes (01A..01E / 02 / 03 / 04) are covered
R4: the permission matrix AUTH-E2E-01..10 passes; cross-project access is 404 with the same body shape as a non-existent resource; insufficient role is 403
R5: AI audit (E2E-017) - with AI off there are zero side effects, with AI on the audit row really lands in ai_audit_log (not merely enqueued)
R6: two-database schema parity (E2E-018) - pcs and pcs_test alembic_version compared, mismatch registered not fixed
R7: the frontend real-backend channel has 6 passing UI flows (5 new + 1 smoke) and the mock channel keeps its 23 passing tests with no regression

R8: contract write-back (roll the OpenAPI baseline, regenerate the frontend types) + SPEC deviation registration (D23..D38) + ledger update (STATUS.md / TODOS.md / buglog.json) + batch-end QA close-out

R9: the PG lane stays the single entry point (`scripts/pytest_pg.sh`), E2E is a separate lane (`scripts/pytest_e2e.sh`), and the two lanes are mutually excluded by a shared flock so they never run concurrently
implementation_units: T1: E2E lane + isolated schema + e2e_client + lane smoke tests + the default-lane skip gate (tests/e2e_flows/conftest.py, tests/e2e_flows/test_lane_smoke.py, tests/scripts/test_pytest_e2e_gate.py, scripts/pytest_e2e.sh)
T2: process-level seed - role matrix, starting states, idempotency (scripts/seed_e2e_flows.py)
T5: record-layer state machine + deliverable revisions (E2E-010..013 + WF-PATH)
T6: permission matrix + AI audit + schema parity (E2E-016 / 017 / 018 + AUTH-E2E)
T7: the 5 real-backend frontend UI flows (pcs-frontend/e2e/real_backend_flows.spec.ts, real_backend_route_sweep.spec.ts)
T8: contract / SPEC deviation write-back + ledger + QA close-out
settled_decisions: This batch does not create a CI pipeline (pre-existing ruling) - the SPEC requirement that E2E runs automatically in CI is not met in this batch; the deviation is registered (D25) and deferred to P10-F.
This batch does not touch alembic/versions/* (the seed only creates data, not schema).
The E2E lane lives in tests/e2e_flows/ (a new sibling directory), not tests/e2e/, because tests/e2e/ is already occupied by 12 unmarked cases that run for real.
The E2E lane does not start the ARQ worker; the audit write task is called directly so the lane depends on less.
AUTH-E2E-11/12 (TEST_VIEWER + the test-report page) are deferred to P10-C (D24).
E2E-018 compares the two databases and registers a mismatch, it does not fix it.
The two lanes share the pcs_pgtest database but each builds its own isolated schema, so they may live in one database yet must never run at the same time (flock).
The calculation-chain input uses synthetic data, not sample/ (sample/ is not in git, so the lane would not be portable).
